finalMessage:
I've added the three Claude 5.5 models to `src/prices.js` and left the existing entries as they were. `npm test` passes: 17 of 17, including the new test.

| Model | input | output | cacheRead | cacheWrite (5 min) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` (prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | 0.1 | 0.5 | 0.01 | 0.125 |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | 2 | 10 | **0.1** | 2.5 |
| `claude-opus-5-5` | 4 | 20 | 0.2 | 5 |

- **The recent change:** on October 7, Anthropic cut Sonnet 5.5 cache reads from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. The `claude-api` reference that came with my tools still listed $0.20. All other Sonnet 5.5 prices stayed the same.
- **Prices on 2026-10-13:** the newest pricing entry in Anthropic's release notes is from October 9. So today's pricing page shows the prices that applied on the 13th. The docs pricing page and claude.com/pricing give the same figures.
- **Existing entries:** the three old models still match the current page. Sonnet 5's $2/$10 price was introductory at launch, but Anthropic has now made it the standard price.
- **Comment and "Last updated" line:** the comment links to the source URL. The "Last updated" line now reads 2026-10-14 and says the prices are as of 2026-10-13. Change it if you'd rather it show only the 13th.
- **Test:** the new test in `test/cost.test.js` costs one request on each new model. It uses different token counts for each usage type, so a swapped or out-of-date price would fail it. The request totals 50,000 prompt tokens, which keeps it in Haiku's lower price band.

**Haiku 5.5 limitation:** Anthropic charges 5× more for Haiku 5.5 requests whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens, and cache reads and writes count toward that total. `costOf` has only one price per model, so it will undercharge those requests. As you asked, I used the lower prices and added a comment on that entry saying longer prompts aren't modelled. Fixing it properly would need a second price band in `costOf`.

Nothing is committed.

Sources:
- [Anthropic pricing docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing)
- [claude.com/pricing](https://claude.com/pricing)
- [Release notes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview) (October 7 Sonnet 5.5 cache-read cut)
- [DEV Community post on the Sonnet 5.5 cache-read cut](https://dev.to/davekurian/claude-sonnet-55-cache-reads-cost-half-measure-your-own-savings-1202) (third-party, agrees with the release notes)
